notes.material: Ti-15Zr, Roxolid-type binary Ti-Zr (V/Al-free, high-strength). NO ASTM OR ISO STANDARD EXISTS for binary Ti-Zr, wrought or AM - Roxolid is Straumann-proprietary; quote your own powder datasheet as the material reference and attach it. (ASTM F2066 is Ti-15 MOLYBDENUM, UNS R58150 - a different alloy, do not substitute)
notes.process: SLM/DMLS + HIP + dehydrogenation bake (01_02 1.3); EAAE may need per-alloy tuning vs 4V baseline
notes.post_process: dehydrogenation bake 250C/10-3 mbar/3h, within 2h of rinse (01_02 1.3 Step 5b) - MANDATORY after EAAE
notes.surface_finish: EAAE dual-scale on the active face: micro Sa 0.5-5 um + nano Sv 50-500 nm (01_02 1.2)
notes.lattice_spec: Not applicable - flat disc coupon, no lattice. (The lattice lives in the Zone-1 anode this coupon stands in for, cem/anchor_zone1.*.json)
notes.coating_restriction: Active face (EBFC Gen 2.0 stack): ZnO-Ta, self-healing 8-HQ and biomimetic (Zn-HAp/chitosan) ALL FORBIDDEN - bare metal only, any dielectric blocks DET (01_02 3.6; RFQ 4.B)
notes.inspection: SEM of the active face BEFORE shipment (01_02 1.5, factory obligation): x5,000 for micro-roughness (report the AREAL Sa of the 01_02 1.2 acceptance row, not a profile Ra) and x50,000 for nano-pores Sv - if nano-pores are not visible at x50,000 the etch is insufficient and EAAE (01_02 1.3 Step 4) is repeated; 01_02 1.5 also names x500 for gyroid macro-pores, which a flat coupon does not have, so that frame does not apply here. CV/EIS biochem (Stage-2, 01_01 6); j on PROJECTED area (01_02 1.4); ICP-MS Zr release (V/Al-free); LECO RH404 H<100 ppm per batch or rejected (01_02 1.3a-C)
extra: Alloy bake-off SKU: V/Al-free + high strength (Straumann dental-proven) = practical anchor candidate alongside the Ta ceiling
Tree-first down-select: CV/EIS + ion-release in synthetic xylem sap, not PBS (01_04 4.2)
